about: Open items a PO noted during a destination check, to settle later. tools/flags.py shows each as a flag until it is removed from this file.

open.title: Bali: Pocket Wifi prices look swapped
open.detail: Pocket Wifi 3GB 4D3N sells at RM120 (cost RM28) but 10GB at RM80 (cost RM48) — the larger plan is cheaper.
open.fix: Confirm both selling prices on the Add On tab.

open.title: Bali: TripCare 360 prices differ from Aceh
open.detail: Bali has only the TripCare set at RM64 (Individual 1–5 days); Aceh and Aceh-Sabang keep the RM45 set (PO 11 Oct 2026).
open.fix: Pick one TripCare price list and use it for Bali too.

open.title: Bangkok: tipping not in the costing
open.detail: The catalog includes Tipping (basis Ground & Tipping) but neither the Chiwanon CR nor the R&D sheet has a tipping cost.
open.fix: Ask Chiwanon whether driver tipping is inside the rate; if not, add a tipping component.

open.title: Bangkok: hotel contracts end 31 Oct 2026
open.detail: Almas, Al-Meroz and Nouvo City contracts are valid to 31 Oct 2026; the catalog is sold to 31 Mar 2027.
open.fix: Get the 2026–27 hotel contracts and update the Almas rates (FIT / group).

open.title: Bangkok: Giraffe Encounter margin under 10%
open.detail: Cost RM122 (CR 1,000 THB), selling RM135 (catalog) — 9.6%.
open.fix: Keep or raise the catalog price.

open.title: Bangkok: 4★ upgrade margin thin
open.detail: Nouvo City Superior Classic 2,000 THB vs Almas 1,250 THB = ~RM46/pax/night against the RM50 upgrade (~9%).
open.fix: Keep or raise the 4★ upgrade surcharge.

open.title: Danang: Ibrahim CR 2027 (alternative TO) margins thin or negative
open.detail: Against catalog − RM200: 5D4N 2 pax −9.3%, 3–4 pax 9.0%; 4D3N 2 pax 8.3%, 4 pax 7.1%, 6 pax 6.2%, 16–20 pax 8.1%. Bismillah (default) 21–50%. Costing 2–20 pax only.
open.fix: Use Ibrahim only where the margin holds, or review the 2027 catalog prices.

open.title: Danang: Bismillah CR ends Dec 2026
open.detail: Bismillah (default TO) CR is Jan–Dec 2026; the catalogs are valid to 31 Dec 2026. Ibrahim has a 2027 CR.
open.fix: Ask Bismillah for the 2027 rates before extending the catalogs into 2027.

open.title: Hanoi - Sapa: Pocket Wifi prices look swapped
open.detail: Pocket Wifi 3GB (4G) 5D4N sells at RM175 (cost RM35) but 10GB (5G) 5D4N at RM150 (cost RM60) — the larger plan is cheaper.
open.fix: Confirm both selling prices on the Add On tab.

open.title: Istanbul - Bursa: cost not on the itinerary's CR row
open.detail: The catalog has 1N Bursa + 3N Istanbul, but the cost uses the MyTrip CR row '5D4N 4N Istanbul' ($980 at 2 pax). The CR has no 3N Istanbul + 1N Bursa row; '6D5N 4N IST + 1N BUR' is $1,030 (2 pax margin ~12% instead of 16.5%).
open.fix: Ask MyTrip for a 5D4N 3N Istanbul + 1N Bursa rate, then update the Ground Cost table (PO hold 13 Oct).

open.title: Istanbul - Bursa: CNB margin 6–10%
open.detail: Child cost is 100% of the adult cost (CR has no child rate), so Child No Bed sells only RM200 below CWB at ~6–10% margin.
open.fix: Decide the child cost rule or ask MyTrip for child rates (PO hold 13 Oct).

open.title: Istanbul - Cappadocia: child cost 100% of adult
open.detail: CR has no child rate; CWB / CNB cost = adult cost (CNB 13–17%).
open.fix: Decide the child cost rule or ask MyTrip for child rates (PO hold 13 Oct).

open.title: Istanbul - Bursa catalog: 5x lunch in includes, 3 in the itinerary
open.detail: Includes say '4x International Breakfast, 5x Lunch, 4x Dinner'; the itinerary has lunch on Day 2–4 only (KB food block also says 5 lunch). PO 13 Oct: keep the catalog text for now.
open.fix: Confirm the lunch count with MyTrip and align includes / itinerary / KB.

open.title: KB turki: meal inclusions in the quotation say breakfast only
open.detail: KB calculator inclusions for Istanbul - Bursa / Cappadocia print '{nights} breakfasts'; the catalogs are fullboard (Bursa 4B/5L/4D, Cappadocia 5B/4L/5D).
open.fix: Set the KB inclusions to the catalog meals (PO hold 13 Oct).

open.title: KB turki: 'Hotel Day 1' for Cappadocia lists the Cappadocia hotels
open.detail: Travel Map table 'Hotel Day 1' (immigration form) shows My Cave / Suhan Cappadocia, but night 1 of Istanbul - Cappadocia is in Istanbul (Viva Deluxe).
open.fix: Confirm with the PO and set the Day 1 hotel to the Istanbul hotel.

open.title: Istanbul: TripCare zone for Turkey
open.detail: TripCare 360 add-ons (Cappadocia and Bursa) use the Etiqa 'Area 2' rates; Turkey may be in another zone.
open.fix: Check the Etiqa zone for Turkey and update the TripCare costs / selling.

open.title: Jakarta - Bandung: KB Jakarta Full Day Tour below cost
open.detail: KB Simple Customisation sells Jakarta Tour (full day) Avanza 2–4 pax at RM320 / transport; the hub cost is RM333 (hub selling RM400).
open.fix: Raise the KB price (e.g. RM400 = hub) or confirm the CTRANS cost.

open.title: Krabi: KTT 2027 rates not in the Costing
open.detail: KTT sent the 2027 high-season rates (11 Jan–30 Apr 2027, Krabi + Honeymoon A/B/C, 17 hotels; new: Andaman Pearl, Aonang Viva, The Phu Beach, Navinda, Chada Thai Village, Krabi La Playa, Apasari Krabi Hotel; Ananta Burin gone). PDFs are in TO Contract Rate.
open.fix: PO to decide how 2027 enters the Costing (new season / new catalog 2027).

open.title: Krabi: no KTT rate for 1 Nov 2026 – 10 Jan 2027
open.detail: The KTT CR 2026 covers 11 Jan–30 Apr (High) and 1 May–31 Oct (Low) only; the catalog sells Nov–Dec 2026 with a RM300 peak surcharge. (Drive also has 3D2N files for 1 Nov–20 Dec 2026, no 4D3N.)
open.fix: Ask KTT for the 4D3N rates 1 Nov 2026 – 10 Jan 2027.

open.title: Krabi: Honeymoon 'High' rates are the Normal rates
open.detail: No KTT honeymoon file for 11 Jan–30 Apr 2026 (A / C); the hub uses the Low-season honeymoon rates for High.
open.fix: Get the honeymoon High rates from KTT (2027 file has them for 2027).

open.title: Krabi CR 2026: possible typos
open.detail: Low HNY C lists Aonang Buri at THB 7,900 (other Low files put it with Apasari / Cha-Da = 7,500) and a stray Silver Orchid 11 Jan–30 Apr line; Blue Tara is 3★ in the High files and 4★ in the Low files; the 'HNY B' High file is a standard Package B.
open.fix: Confirm with KTT.

open.title: Yunnan 3 Wilayah: CR tipping 7 days vs Costing 6 days
open.detail: The Tourdechina CR 3W 7D5N says tipping RMB30/pax/day × 7 days (same text as the 4W CR); Day 7 is the flight only, so the Costing keeps × 6 days (PO 10 Oct 2026). At × 7 the cost is RMB30 (≈RM18) per pax higher.
open.fix: Ask Tourdechina whether 3W tipping is 6 or 7 days.

open.title: Yunnan 4 Wilayah: single supplement RM700 vs CR RMB1,120
open.detail: Catalog single supplement RM700/person; CR S/SUPP RMB1,120/pax for 2–9 pax ≈ RM684 at FX 0.6104 (margin ≈2 %), RMB780 for 10–14 pax ≈ RM476. 3W: RM600 vs RMB800 ≈ RM488 (fine).
open.fix: Decide whether to raise the 4W single supplement (catalog + KB) or accept the thin margin.

open.title: Yunnan 3 + 4 Wilayah: add-on costs unknown
open.detail: Airport transfer (MPV / Small Bus / Big Bus), bullet train 1st / Business class upgrade, luggage van, Indian/Arabic meal and One Day Tour have cost RM0 in both KMGDL and KMGDLS (not in the Tourdechina CRs). Extra lunch / dinner cost RM61 = CR meal budget at 2–3 pax (sold at RM60).
open.fix: Ask Tourdechina for these rates, then fill the costs on the Add On tab (both packages).

open.title: Turki Klasik Basic: cost = CR − $200 (not in the CR)
open.detail: The MyTrip CR has one '8D7N Classic Turki Tour' rate (= Standard: full board, Viva Deluxe). Basic (breakfast only, Ramada Pera) is costed at that rate − $200/pax, an ARBA estimate from the R&D sheet (May 2026).
open.fix: Ask MyTrip for a Basic (breakfast-only) rate, then update the 'Basic −$200' rate.

open.title: Turki Klasik: child cost 100 % — CNB margin thin
open.detail: The CR has no child rate, so CWB / CNB cost = adult (ARBA May 2026). CNB sells RM400 below adult: Standard CNB margin ≈4–6 % at 2–6 pax, Basic CNB ≈0–4 % at 10–24 pax (FX 4.086).
open.fix: Ask MyTrip for child-with-bed / no-bed rates, or review the CNB catalog price.

open.title: Turki Klasik: single supplement cost unknown
open.detail: Catalog single supplement RM1,000/person; the MyTrip CR has no single rate.
open.fix: Ask MyTrip for the single supplement.

open.title: KB turki: transport rate card amounts look too high for RM
open.detail: Simple Customisation 'Raw Costing — Rate Card Operator' (all 4 Turki packages): e.g. Istanbul ↔ Ankara Sprinter RM37,000, Vito RM7,000, Pamukkale ↔ Istanbul RM12,700 per vehicle. They may be in another currency (TRY?).
open.fix: Confirm the source rate card and its currency before Sales quote custom itineraries.
